title: The Day a Wave of Molasses Hit Boston #Shorts

hook.narration: In nineteen nineteen, a wave of molasses killed twenty-one people in Boston.

visuals.prompt: A towering dark wave of molasses surging down a snowy 1919 Boston street between brick buildings

scenes.narration: It was a mild January afternoon when a giant storage tank in the North End split open.

visuals.prompt: A huge riveted industrial molasses tank beside the Boston harbour, early 1919, overcast sky

scenes.narration: More than two million gallons burst out in a wave about twenty-five feet high, racing along at roughly thirty-five miles an hour.

visuals.prompt: The riveted tank bursting apart with a wall of dark syrup rushing outward, 1919 street, motion blur
Terrified people and horses fleeing along a Boston street as a brown wave closes in

scenes.narration: It crushed buildings, buckled the elevated railway, and trapped people in thick, sticky syrup. Twenty-one people died.

visuals.prompt: A wrecked brick building and a twisted elevated railway structure coated in thick molasses, rescuers wading through it
Rescue workers in 1919 coats pulling a survivor from knee-deep syrup

scenes.narration: The company blamed anarchists. A court blamed the company.

visuals.prompt: A stern 1920s courtroom with a judge and lawyers, lamplight, a model of a tank on the table

description: The Great Molasses Flood of 1919 sent a deadly wave of syrup through Boston's North End. Here is what happened, and who was really to blame. #Shorts #History

thumbnail.prompt: A dark glossy wave of molasses engulfing a 1919 Boston street, dramatic sepia and blue tones
